verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video, character references, facial-expression transfer and character transformation, but nothing about turning a pasted script into a presenter-led video with a stock or custom talking avatar. There is no evidence of a lip-synced presenter, voiceover or avatar library. Character reference and performance transfer are adjacent generative features, and performance transfer needs existing footage, so neither delivers this story.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
